prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1056; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described in the enclosed file materials. The client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on impact and is currently receiving medical care. Effective immediately, all communication regarding this claim, including requests for statements, medical authorizations, or settlement discussions, must be directed to this office and not to our client. Please confirm in writing that you have made a note of this instruction on your claim file.

We also request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including all liability coverage limits and any applicable excess or umbrella coverage that may apply to the insured driver. Please identify every policy under which coverage may be available so that we can evaluate the claim properly.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle inspection reports, telematics or event data recorder information, recorded statements, adjuster notes, and any communications with other parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these materials. We look forward to your prompt written response.
